poses.caption: Hold a straight-body plank with shins supported on the stability ball
Lift hips into a pike as the ball rolls toward planted hands

jobs.detail: TWO equal SIDE-BY-SIDE panels of JACK KNIFE ON BALL. Same SIDE VIEW, head IMAGE LEFT, ball IMAGE RIGHT. LEFT high plank, both flat palms on floor directly below shoulders, arms straight, long straight diagonal head-hip-heel line. Both shins/top feet rest firmly on TOP of large gray spherical STABILITY BALL, ball supports lower legs; toes not touching floor. RIGHT keep palms in EXACT same floor position, arms straight, shoulders stacked over wrists; lift HIPS HIGH into inverted-V pike, both knees NEARLY STRAIGHT; ball rolls LEFT toward hands while feet/top toes remain supported on ball upper surface. Torso descends diagonally from high pelvis to shoulders, legs descend diagonally from pelvis to ball; head neutral between upper arms. Ball remains same diameter, on floor in both panels, no levitation, NO tucked knees. Red primary ABS only low-contrast soft blur on opaque black abdominal shirt, no torso muscle window. Gray legs/arms and entire ball visible.
jobs.prompt: Correct ONLY the RIGHT pike panel of this original two-panel male stability-ball exercise illustration. LEFT plank panel unchanged. In RIGHT panel roll the SAME diameter stability ball noticeably LEFT toward his planted hands, approximately half the ball diameter (about 130 pixels in this composition), while ball stays on floor at same height. Move BOTH supported shoes/top feet LEFT with the ball, maintain secure top-foot support on upper ball surface. Redraw both NEARLY STRAIGHT legs connecting existing high pelvis to closer feet, preserving the man's ORIGINAL anatomical leg lengths/proportions from LEFT panel: do not stretch legs or make knees tuck. Keep high hips and straight-arm pike, align hands/shoulders with LEFT panel's planted hand positions relative to each panel boundary, palms flat and arms straight. Preserve man identity, grayscale exposed anatomy, continuous fully opaque black sleeveless shirt and knee-length black shorts wrapping seat/crotch, diffuse red abdominal cloth tint, pure white background and equal two-panel layout. No new equipment, no text. Whole ball/shoes remain in own panel with white margin.
jobs.inspectionNote: Ball now clearly rolls toward hands with feet closer to pelvis and nearly straight legs of more consistent proportions. Opaque shirt tint from prior correction retained. All anatomy, neck alignment, planted hands and load/range review pending.

poses.caption: Stand with both kettlebells at shoulder height in rack position
Press one kettlebell overhead while the opposite bell stays racked
Return the first bell to rack and press the opposite kettlebell overhead

jobs.detail: THREE equal SIDE-BY-SIDE panels of KETTLEBELL ALTERNATING PRESS, same FRONT three-quarter view. Feet shoulder-width planted, neutral upright ribcage/pelvis, no leg drive/back arch. Exactly TWO matching gray round kettlebells per panel, each has arched metal HANDLE fully enclosed in one hand and round BODY hanging below handle/resting against OUTSIDE/back of wrist/forearm. LEFT both elbows bent, bells held at shoulder height in secure rack, wrists neutral. MIDDLE model RIGHT arm (IMAGE LEFT) extends overhead fully straight with right wrist over elbow over shoulder, bell mass rests behind/outside right forearm; LEFT arm remains bent at shoulder holding its bell in rack. RIGHTmost reverse: RIGHT arm returned to same shoulder rack, model LEFT arm (IMAGE RIGHT) now extends overhead, bell behind/outside forearm. Arms pass in scapular plane, bells do not merge into hands or disappear, no floating handles. Same two bells/grips/person across panels. Primary DELTOIDS exposed red only at BOTH shoulder caps in all three phases; pectorals/triceps/forearms neutral gray. Shirt entirely solid black no chest tint. Fully opaque clothes front/back/seat/crotch. Generous top margin above overhead bells and bottom below shoes, whole fingers and bells visible.
